states.title: Start
states.description: You wake up in a dark room. The air is still and heavy, and the silence is unnerving. Somehow, you feel like you've been here before, yet you don't remember why nor how. There's not quite anything to do at the moment, so you might as well explore. You could also try to look into the darkness for something useful, although it's going to be very hard to see anything in the dark until you find a reliable source of light.

req-desciptions.description: You wake up again in the dark room. The silence is deafening. You know the drill by now.
You wake up once again in the dark room for what seems like hundreds of times. Maybe this time you'll finally learn more about how you got here.

states.title: Sat Down
states.description: You sit down, expecting to feel the cold floor beneath your feet. But instead, you find yourself in another dark room. Again.

states.title: Looking Around?
states.description: As you look around, an unknown force suddenly strikes you. In an instant, you feel a cold breeze that quickly envelops you. It seems familiar but also seems to deprive you of your energy. You try to shake it off and focus, hoping to spot a clue amidst the darkness, only to find that the effort makes your head spin. You have no choice but to give up and submit to the darkness.

req-desciptions.description: You gaze into the darkness. The entities lurking there rush towards you, but the faint glow of the stone in your pocket pulses violently. The shadows hiss and retreat! The stone protects you, though you feel it draining your warmth to do so. It is safe to look around for a moment.
As you had anticipated, the darkness quickly envelops you. At this point you already know resistance is futile. You give up and submit to the darkness.

states.title: Devoured by Echoes
states.description: The noise you made echoes endlessly through the metallic corridors. Something heard you. Something fast. Before you can react, the darkness consumes you.

states.title: Victory
states.description: The door slides open, revealing a blinding white light. You step through, leaving the loop behind. You have won the game.

states.title: Found a Small Stone
states.description: You make your best effort to explore the area, but can't find much due to the darkness. As you are about to give up, however, you notice a small stone on the ground, faintly glowing and pulsing in the dark. You feel a strange warmth emanating from it. For some reason, the stone feels — you suddenly realize — strangely familiar, but you don't quite remember exactly when or why you've seen it before.

req-desciptions.description: After exploring the area for a while, you soon find the cold stone again, still glowing and pulsing in the dark. But this time, it's in a slightly different place than you remember. "That's strange, I thought it was over there," you think to yourself.

options.action: Leave the stone behind and continue exploring
Sit down and try to figure out what you remember about the stone

states.title: A Magic Stone?
states.description: You pick up the stone. It feels smooth and light. As you touch it, you notice a faint, warm vibration emanating from its core. What's strange though is that it feels cold to the touch, yet somehow also seems to heat you up. You should probably do something with it.

options.action: Put the stone in your pocket

states.title: Left the stone behind
states.description: You put the stone back down. Maybe you can get it later. Or, have you already changed your mind?

states.title: A Magic Stone?
states.description: Shrugging, you decide to put it in your pocket. Maybe you can figure out a way to use it?

options.action: Look around to see if there are more objects
Sit down and think about how to use it

states.title: A Hidden Door
states.description: You make your best effort to continue exploring the area, but can't find much due to the darkness. However, this time, your hand brushes against a cold, metallic surface. As you feel around, you feel what appears to be a handle. It must be some sort of door. But where does it lead to? You have not the slightest idea.

options.action: Sit down and think about what to do next
Go back and check the stone you ignored
Go back to get the cold stone
Try to open the metallic door
Touch the door with the Cold Stone
Inspect the faint markings near the door

states.title: Locked Tight
states.description: You pull on the handle, but it doesn't budge. It seems to be magnetically sealed. There is no keyhole, only a strange indentation that looks like it requires an object to fit into it.

states.title: The Glowing Glyphs
states.description: As you lean closer to the metallic wall, glowing text flickers into existence. It reads: 'I am the beginning of the endless, the only even among the odd. Speak my name to proceed.' Below the text, a keypad materializes.

req-desciptions.description: You look at the wall. The glyphs are dull and lifeless. You have already solved this riddle in a previous life. The knowledge is still in your head.

states.title: Incorrect
states.description: The glyphs turn an angry red. A high-pitched screech emits from the wall, piercing your ears. The floor drops from beneath you.

states.title: Correct
states.description: The glyphs pulse green and fade away. You feel a surge of intellectual clarity. While the door doesn't open, you hear a mechanical click. Perhaps you unlocked something elsewhere, or maybe you just gained knowledge.

states.title: Opened the Door
states.description: You press the cold stone against the indentation. The stone heats up intensely, glowing bright blue. The metallic door hisses and slides open.
